# Technical Documentation

This directory contains internal documentation intended for developers contributing to the GRAM language compiler or building tools on top of it.

## Contents

*   **[Parsing Architecture](./01_parsing_architecture.md)**
    *   Detailed breakdown of the 3-stage pipeline: Parsing (OhmJS), AST Generation, and Compilation.
    *   Explanation of section scopes, stack logic, and the central registry.

*   **[JSON Output Schema](./02_json_output.md)**
    *   Reference guide for the JSON structure generated by the compiler.
    *   Useful for frontend developers displaying recipes.
